Tucker said his Buy rating on CenterPoint

is driven by Houston Electric's unmatched exposure to residential and industrial growth, supporting ~10 GW of incremental demand by 2031 at a forecast 13% compound annual growth rate; while the Batch Zero audit may create headline risk, the analyst views Houston's economic and population growth as a powerful catalyst for rate base and earnings expansion.
